faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Akashvani Jalandhar Part Time Correspondent (PTC) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Part Time Correspondent (PTC) post is 07 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Part Time Correspondent (PTC) post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualifications include Secondary, Higher Secondary, +2, Graduation, Post Graduation, and a degree in Journalism.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Part Time Correspondent (PTC) post?
faq.answer: The notification indicates 0 vacancies for the Part Time Correspondent (PTC) post. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for the most accurate and up-to-date information.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the Part Time Correspondent (PTC) position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Part Time Correspondent (PTC) position is contractual.

faq.question: Q7. Where is Akashvani Jalandhar located?
faq.answer: Akashvani Jalandhar is located in Jalandhar, Punjab, with the pincode 144001.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. Online applications will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates should attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates with the application form.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Akashvani Jalandhar, which is www.newsonair.gov.in.
